interpretation.label: metrics_never_comparable

preconditions.name: capture_buffer_length_exact
preconditions.control: `run_zworld_p0` calls the target fn exactly once per buffered step, so a tap on it has length delta exactly 0 by construction
preconditions.description: The post-hoc probe's captured world_obs buffer must be the same length the substrate reported buffering. A non-zero delta means the capture seam moved and the probe is reading a different dataset than the one that trained.

preconditions.name: split_replay_mean_predictor_mse_exact
preconditions.control: `mean_predictor_mse` reported by the substrate's own preservation_holdout block on the SD-106 cells -- it is a function of the whole buffer, the permutation and n_train, so an exact match proves the reproduced split is the substrate's
preconditions.description: The reproduced train/holdout split must equal the trainer's. Scoped to SD-106 cells: the OFF track builds no preservation head and therefore reports no reference base to compare against; capture_buffer_length_exact is the check that covers every cell.

preconditions.name: probe_system_overdetermined
preconditions.control: n_train minus the OLS design-matrix width (world_obs_dim + 1) on the identity control; positive means least-squares rather than minimum-norm
preconditions.description: REACHABILITY of the identity gate below, measured rather than assumed. Under-determined, the identity control cannot return unity on ANY correct implementation, so gating on it would be unmeetable by construction.

preconditions.name: identity_probe_recovers_unity
preconditions.control: world_obs -> world_obs: the identity map is inside the OLS family, so this returns ~1.0 on ANY data, on any machine, at any budget
preconditions.description: INSTRUMENT GATE 1, data-independent. If the probe cannot recover unity from the identity control, a low posthoc_ols_r2 on the trained code is the probe's arithmetic failing, not the encoder's, and no outcome is attributable. Deliberately NOT an absolute PCA-32 floor: the PCA-32 level is a property of the DATA (0.893 on the P0a buffer vs the design doc's 0.9984 on some other distribution), so a floor on it would gate the science on the dataset rather than the probe.

preconditions.name: pca32_is_the_optimal_32dim_linear_code
preconditions.control: PCA-32 minimises reconstruction MSE over all rank-32 linear codes of its own input (Eckart-Young), so no trained 32-dim code can exceed it beyond held-out estimation noise
preconditions.description: INSTRUMENT GATE 2, mathematically grounded. A trained code beating the PCA-32 anchor by more than the tolerance means the split or the projection is wrong, not that the encoder beat PCA.

preconditions.name: sd106_bypass_trained_off_zero
preconditions.control: the bypass is zero-initialised, so a norm above zero is proof P0a actually stepped it; V3-EXQ-1023 measured 4.13-4.37
preconditions.description: The SD-106 manipulation must have happened. A zero norm means the flag read as enabled while the mechanism stayed inert.

preconditions.name: shipped_cell_reproduces_1023_sgd_r2
preconditions.description: REPRODUCTION GATE. The b_shipped SD-106 cells re-run V3-EXQ-1023's exact P0a config, so their sgd_head_r2 must land on 1023's recorded 0.6999-0.7490. Tolerance 0.05 absolute, not machine-epsilon: 1023 ran on linux-x86_64/torch2.12 and ~400 Adam steps do not reproduce bit-identically across machine classes. A config error reads ~0.94, 0.19 away, which this bar still catches.

preconditions.control: analytic: the three shares sum to 1 and are bounded, so the leading share's margin over the runner-up spans [-1, 1]; a 0.15 lead sits at 0.15 of the achievable 1.0, i.e. well inside it, on ANY dataset
preconditions.description: DV headroom for the load-bearing criteria. The margin's reachable range is a property of the decomposition, not of this run's data, which is exactly why the routing was moved off a transferred bar. The EMPIRICAL half of feasibility -- that the gap the shares divide is itself non-degenerate -- is carried by shortfall_gap_positive below, measured rather than assumed.
preconditions.name: share_margin_headroom
preconditions.headroom_reason: DV headroom met: share_margin (leading share minus runner-up) can reach 1 (analytic ceiling supplied by the caller, not measured from a sample), against a required 0.3 (criterion threshold 0.15 x margin 2).

preconditions.name: shortfall_gap_positive
preconditions.control: pca32_ols_r2 minus sgd_head_r2 at b_shipped -- the shortfall V3-EXQ-1023 reported, measured against the in-run achievable ceiling; 0.1390 on the authoring seed
preconditions.description: The three explanatory shares are fractions of this gap. With a gap at or below zero they are undefined or unstable, and no route is attributable.

preconditions.name: ceiling_stable_across_budgets
preconditions.control: pca32_ols_r2 per budget against the b_shipped value on the same seed; 0.004 on the authoring seed (0.8880 at 60 episodes, 0.8840 at 100)
preconditions.description: RED-TEAM F5. Every share uses the b_shipped ceiling as its single denominator, so a budget that moved the ceiling itself could present a denominator effect as a budget effect.

preconditions.name: budget_manipulation_reached_substrate
preconditions.control: n_steps is computed by the substrate as (n_train // batch_size) * epochs, so the delta is read off the trainer, not asserted
preconditions.description: Non-degeneracy for the budget factor: b_steps1200 must actually have run many more optimiser steps than b_shipped at the same data.

criteria.name: C1_metric_share_dominant
criteria.detail: median over seeds of (posthoc_ols_r2 - sgd_head_r2) / gap at b_shipped, minus the larger of the other two shares. Routes outcome (1) metrics_never_comparable: the reported metric under-read the code

criteria.name: C2_budget_share_dominant
criteria.detail: median over seeds of (best-budget posthoc_ols_r2 - b_shipped posthoc_ols_r2) / gap, minus the larger of the other two shares. Routes outcome (2) under_budgeted_p0a

criteria.name: C3_residual_share_dominant
criteria.detail: median over seeds of 1 - metric_share - budget_share, minus the larger of the other two shares: what neither the metric nor the budget explains. Routes outcome (3), split by the paired OFF comparison into mechanism_defect_inert_at_dv (sd106 <= off) and mechanism_defect_below_ceiling (sd106 > off)

interpretation.combination_rule: SHORTFALL DECOMPOSITION, not an AND/OR of PASSes. Per seed at b_shipped: gap = pca32_ols_r2 - sgd_head_r2; metric_share = (posthoc_ols_r2 - sgd_head_r2)/gap; budget_share = (best-budget posthoc_ols_r2 - posthoc_ols_r2)/gap; residual_share = 1 - metric_share - budget_share. The three sum to 1 by construction, so AT MOST ONE can lead the runner-up by any positive margin and the criteria are a partition. The route is the leader when its margin reaches DOMINANCE_MARGIN (0.15), else `no_dominant_explanation` -- which is a RESULT, not an instrument failure: it says the shortfall has no single dominant cause, and the recorded shares say how it splits. A failed precondition overrides everything and self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue. `outcome` is PASS when the diagnostic DISCRIMINATED (gate green and a share dominant), FAIL when it did not -- never a verdict on SD-106, which this run does not score.

routes.metrics_never_comparable: The code is already at PCA-32 parity under a post-hoc probe, so the in-training SGD head metric and the design-time post-hoc probe were never the same statistic. Mechanism and budget are both fine. Promote the generic-vs-task-relevant compression /lit-pull to primary; the consumer-rung shortfall V3-EXQ-1023 measured is an OBJECTIVE-CHOICE question.
routes.under_budgeted_p0a: P0a is under-budgeted. Raise the budget and re-run the acceptance measurement. Read the steps-vs-data contrast (b_steps600 vs b_designref at ~equal steps, b_shipped/600/1200 at equal data) to say WHICH.
routes.mechanism_defect_below_ceiling: Neither the metric nor the budget explains the shortfall, and the preservation term DOES beat the paired OFF arm at b_shipped -- so the mechanism works but undershoots the achievable ceiling across a 3.3x step range at fixed data AND a 1.7x data range at fixed steps. Route to /implement-substrate on the preservation leg's own code. Does NOT license a re-queue at another preservation_weight.
routes.mechanism_defect_inert_at_dv: As above, but the SD-106 arm does NOT beat the paired OFF arm at b_shipped: the preservation term is INERT at the DV despite a non-zero bypass norm. A different build from the one above -- the term is not reaching the code, rather than reaching it and undershooting.
routes.no_dominant_explanation: No share leads the runner-up by DOMINANCE_MARGIN. This is a RESULT, not an instrument failure: the shortfall has no single dominant cause and the recorded per-seed shares say how it splits. Governance should read the shares rather than treat the run as unrun.
routes.substrate_not_ready_requeue: A precondition failed. No outcome is attributable; this is an instrument result, not a verdict on SD-106.

interpretation.residual_ambiguity: The swept budget range is 3.3x in optimiser steps and 1.7x in observations. A flat reading is evidence against a budget explanation WITHIN that range and is not a proof about arbitrarily larger budgets; the design doc's own named reference point (600 steps, 4000 observations) IS inside the range, which is what makes outcome (3) actionable rather than merely unresolved.
